items.wordHook: 一(one) clean 切(cut) slices through all items at once: 一切 means all, everything.
下(down) + 課(lesson): the lesson comes down, so class is dismissed.
孩(baby) + 子(child) → a young one: 孩子(child).
A 今(now) over a 心(heart) means your thoughts stay in the present → 念(think of).
a 木(tree) holds 果(fruit) on every bough → one 棵(measure word for trees).
Combining 榜(placard) and 樣(form): 榜樣 means model, example.
Combining 腐(spoil) and 敗(failure): 腐敗 means putrid, rotten.
說(speak) + 話(speech) → 說話 means to talk.
a 垂(hang) post rests at the 阝(place) → letters wait: 郵(mail).
